name: Canvas Fly #438
description: Painted by a real fruit-fly nervous system: 165,122 traced neurons of the male Drosophila CNS connectome (Janelia FlyEM, Cambridge Connectomics, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0), simulated as leaky integrate-and-fire units. The retina looked at the canvas, the descending neurons moved the brush, population activity chose the colour. 6.0 s of brain time, 1 strokes, 1,691,843 spikes. Seed 1665339204 — replayable to the pixel with the same graph. Nobody drew this. Watch it being painted: https://connectomecanvas.com/demo#438

attributes.value: FlyEM male CNS connectome v1.0 (minconf 0.5, traced only)
